text:
marco: quick follow-up from today's all-hands security panel. collecting clarifications on SOC2/ISO artifacts, VPC connectivity choices, audit-log exports & KMS/BYOK rotation. posting answers and next steps here.

elena: TL;DR first: we can provide SOC2 evidence bundles, ISO mappings, export audit logs, and support BYOK. details below and owners named.

priya: SOC2/ISO evidence: we produce a packaged bundle (control mappings, logs, config snapshots, and test artifacts). request via the compliance form: https://bit.ly/rwd-compliance. include `org`, `project`, `control_scope` and `evidence_owner`. expect 3 business days for full manual packs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

dan: audit-log exports: hosted tenants get exports to our managed bucket `s3://redwood-logs/audit/<region>/` by default. private & VPC deployments export into customer buckets via an IAM role we create. default retention = 90 days; to request 180/365 days set `retention_days` in your compliance request. example export pattern: `s3://<customer-bucket>/redwood/audit/<cluster-id>/YYYY/MM/DD/`

liz: perms question — does product need to create buckets or do you handle role setup?

elena: for Private we create a cross-account export role in your account. you provide an S3 bucket arn and the principals to allow. for hosted customers we can set up a signed export snapshot to your bucket if required.

marco: VPC connectivity options? we're deciding between Interface Endpoints vs PrivateLink vs peering.

d an: recommended: Interface Endpoints (AWS PrivateLink backed) for control-plane & API traffic. PrivateLink is the path we use for hosted-managed integrations. VPC peering is allowed only for eval/test but not recommended for prod due to routing limits & security surface. ping eng-platform for a short arch review.

priya: KMS/BYOK: we support AWS CMKs + BYOK with imported key material. rotation: automatic AWS rotation is supported for CMKs; for imported keys we require a rotation schedule in the onboarding doc. we generally advise rotation every 90 days for high-sensitivity customers. HSM-backed flows are available — contact security for the onboarding checklist.

opsbot: Created compliance ticket COMP-2077 to track evidence & extended retention requests from this thread.

liz: can we get a one-pager checklist and the IAM policy example?

elena: yes. action: dan will post a checklist + example bucket policy + sample `aws iam` role create snippet in #eng-docs by EOD tomorrow.

dan: sample role snippet I'll post (short):
```
aws iam create-role --role-name redwood-audit-exporter --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name redwood-audit-exporter --policy-name export-policy --policy-document file://export-policy.json
```

marco: can you also include instructions for capturing KV/prefix cache traces for evidence?

priya: yes — include cache trace flags and a short guidance on safe capture windows. mention to coordinate capture with platform so we don't impact latency SLOs.

elena: office hours: security + eng-platform will run a 45m session next Wed 10am PT for SOC2/ISO/VPC/KMS Qs. sign-up: https://meet.redwood.ai/sec-office. we'll publish slides & a runbook afterwards.

liz: thanks all. i'll collect questions from product leads and post them here before the office hours. :slightly_smiling_face:

elena: closing loop for now. any urgent compliance asks — ping @priya or open COMP-2077. we'll update the ticket with the bundle ETA and required artifacts.
